source.section: Form 40 (25f40blk.pdf page 1) lines 5b to 18; booklet PDF page 8 lines 5 to 13, PDF page 10 lines 14 and 17; PDF page 9 Standard Deduction chart (line 11, PDF page 8): head of family column row '$30,000 - $30,499' 3,985; Form 40 page 1 boxes 1 to 4 (personal exemption, line 13) (box 4, 3,000); tax table PDF pages 25 to 30

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 30,250.00 = 30,250.00. Federal taxable income = 30,250.00 - 23,625.00 federal standard deduction = 6,625.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Alabama: the projection starts from federal AGI and removes exempt income (Form 40 builds its own lines 5b to 10, which give the same AGI for this household). Form 40 line 10 Alabama AGI = 30,250.00. Line 11 standard deduction (head of family, chart PDF page 9): AL AGI 30,250.00 is over 29,999.00, the band 30,000.00 to 30,499.00, so 3,985.00. Line 12 federal income tax deduction: the form subtracts the 2025 federal income tax (worksheet PDF page 31); the projection does not model it (not_modelled, approximation), so 0.00 here. Line 13 personal exemption (head of family) 3,000.00. Line 14 dependent exemption 0.00 (no dependents claimed; the qualifying person on Schedule HOF need not be a dependent). Line 15 total deductions = 3,985.00 + 0.00 + 3,000.00 + 0.00 = 6,985.00. Line 16 taxable income = 30,250.00 - 6,985.00 = 23,265.00. Line 17 tax from the derived single / married filing separately / head of family schedule (2% from 0, 4% from 500, 5% from 3,000): (500.00 - 0.00) x 0.02 = 10.00 + (3,000.00 - 500.00) x 0.04 = 100.00 + (23,265.00 - 3,000.00) x 0.05 = 1,013.25 = 1,123.25; the tax table row 23,200-23,300 (single / married filing separately / head of family column, PDF pages 25 to 30) gives 1,123. Line 18 net tax due, no credits: 1,123.25.
accepted_approximations: The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).

The brackets are derived from the tax table. Under 100,000 the table taxes each 100-dollar row at its midpoint, rounded; above 100,000 the printed worksheet ((income - 100,000) x .05 + 4,958, or + 4,918 joint) is 2 dollars below the derived brackets.
